query: Help me understand the key points in this table — what should I concentrate on?

per_column.name: service_quality_assessment
per_column.rationale: This is a holistic quality verdict (poor/excellent/good) that restates the whole concept rather than isolating one constitutive aspect of it.

per_column.name: seat_comfort_experience
per_column.rationale: Physical comfort of the seat is a genuine aspect-of the flying experience and a constitutive part of service quality.

per_column.name: food_beverage_quality
per_column.rationale: Catering quality is a distinct constitutive component of the onboard service offering.

per_column.name: operational_reliability
per_column.rationale: Punctuality/delays/cancellations are a bona fide dimension of the service delivered (the schedule performance facet), part-of overall service quality.

per_column.name: crew_professionalism
per_column.rationale: Staff/crew conduct and attentiveness is a core constitutive facet of the human-service aspect of quality.

per_column.name: sentiment_direction
per_column.rationale: Overall positive/negative/mixed sentiment is an aggregate valence of the whole review, restating the global evaluation rather than decomposing a specific facet.

judge.rationale: Four of the six columns (seat comfort, food/beverage, operational reliability, crew professionalism) are genuine part-of facets that carve service quality into distinct non-overlapping dimensions. However, two columns fail the meronymy test: 'service_quality_assessment' and 'sentiment_direction' are holistic restatements of the whole concept, not constitutive parts, and they overlap heavily with each other and with the whole, lowering mutual exclusivity. Exhaustiveness is moderate: the true facets cover cabin comfort, catering, punctuality, and staff, but leave gaps (e.g., inflight entertainment, boarding/ground process, value-for-money/pricing, cabin cleanliness). Because a substantial portion of the set consists of whole-concept restatements rather than facets, the decomposition only partially satisfies the faceted (MECE part-of) claim.
